challenge.heading: Transitioning from reactive treatment to proactive risk management
challenge.body:
An emerging European biotech company sought to establish a value-based partnership with a Spanish regional health system to transition from reactive cardiovascular disease treatment to proactive risk management.

The health system faced rising hospitalisation costs and delayed diagnosis of high-risk patients, while the biotech needed to demonstrate real-world evidence of their innovative cardiovascular therapies in a preventive care model.

approach.heading: A data-driven population health management programme
approach.intro: We designed and implemented a programme integrating multiple digital and clinical touchpoints:

items.title: Risk Stratification Engine
items.description: Deployed machine learning algorithms across regional health datasets to identify patients with elevated cardiovascular risk profiles based on biomarkers, comorbidities, and social determinants of health.

items.title: Omnichannel Patient Engagement
items.description: Established a coordinated call centre and digital platform to increase disease awareness, facilitate biomarker screening, and guide patients through the cardiovascular risk assessment pathway.

items.title: Remote Monitoring Infrastructure
items.description: Provisioned connected devices and patient education kits to enable continuous monitoring of key cardiovascular metrics, supported by clinical protocols for escalation and treatment optimisation.

items.title: Pathway Redesign
items.description: Reengineered the care pathway from diagnosis through treatment, integrating the biotech's novel therapies as part of guideline-concordant care for identified high-risk patients.

pathway.alt: Four-step cardiovascular risk management programme pathway leading to measurable outcomes

teaser: An emerging European biotech needed to demonstrate real-world evidence of their cardiovascular therapies in a preventive care model. We designed a data-driven population health programme that identified high-risk patients earlier and reduced hospitalisations — within 18 months.
title: Healthcare Pathway Transformation: Proactive Cardiovascular Risk Management
